subject: extraction of the sample covariance matrix

messages.author: ad9c88d25a471650
messages.subject: extraction of the sample covariance matrix
parts:
Hi!
Without success, I have been trying to find a command that will display/extract the sample covariance matrix. The fitted() command gives me the implied cov matrix; the resid() gives me a matrix with the residuals, but I really need the sample cov matrix. I have missing data in my data set (using the "fiml" command), and I want to see the cov matrix Lavaan works with. Is this possible?

Best Regards,
Johanna Stålnacke

messages.author: af82fa98896529e2
messages.subject: Re: extraction of the sample covariance matrix
parts:
You may extract by using

output@SampleStats@cov # for covariances
output@SampleStats@mean # for means

Let me put my two cents. I am not sure how lavaan calculate sample statistics here. Why don't you fit a saturated model and use the model implied means and covariances from there.

Sunthud
